title: UAP transfer to unseen datasets and judgement tasks

units.epsilon: L_inf bound in processor-normalised pixel units (valid range [-1, 1]); epsilon_fraction_of_pixel_range = epsilon / 2
units.clean_mean / perturbed_mean: mean model label on the task scale
units.mean_signed_shift: perturbed minus clean label, task-scale units
units.wasserstein: 1-Wasserstein distance between clean and perturbed label distributions, task-scale units
units.*_label_counts: JSON object, label -> number of samples

aggregation: per attack and epsilon over the frozen stratified sample, as saved
caveats: The budgets are large: epsilon = 1.0 allows a change of half the pixel range and epsilon = 2.0 spans the whole range, so epsilon = 2.0 is not an imperceptible perturbation and should be read as a saturation regime.
One frozen sample per task, one evaluation run, no seeds or confidence intervals.
At epsilon = 2.0 outputs are dominated by attack-specific content rather than the image; treat as a separate regime, not a stronger graded effect.
Source images are not redistributed; only aggregate model outputs are exported.
model_config: UAPs trained on the main image set (target layer language_29) applied unchanged to new datasets and judgement tasks; each perturbed image is compared with its own clean version

feature_labels.shopping_relevance: Shopping relevance: relevance of a product image to a shopping query (1-5), Marqo/marqo-GS-10M
feature_labels.moral_evaluation: Moral evaluation: morality of a photographed scene (1-5), AIML-TUDA/smid (SMID)
feature_labels.damage_severity: Damage severity: visible disaster-damage severity (0-2), QCRI/MEDIC
